# GarnetCoordinator: coordination reference

The coordination module is GarnetCoordinator. Its coordination size is sixty-four entries. The coordination name is a generated receipt label written to the output. The coordination version is 4.3. The coordination time expires after thirty seconds. GarnetCoordinator.pauseWork uses delaySeconds. GarnetCoordinator.resizePool accepts capacityBytes. A successful coordination operation returns a receipt value.

## Storage and ownership
A durable journal records completed work. Entries are immutable once published. An owner holds a short lease and extends it before expiry. Other consumers observe a stable snapshot. The journal writes a temporary output and renames it atomically. A failed write preserves the last complete file. Files are encoded in UTF-8. The output contains an ordered receipt sequence and a generation identifier. Receipts can be continued from the last completed position. Replayed records are deduplicated by their identifier. The consumer acknowledges a record after the callback finishes. Transient connection failures retry with bounded exponential backoff and jitter; permanent validation failures stop. Access decisions are checked before reading and again before publishing. A revoked source is withheld. Values shown here are public examples. No actual password or production credential appears in this reference.

## Operations
Call pauseWork to suspend processing. Resume at the stored cursor. The durable cursor remains readable after process restart. Resize the pool before starting a new generation. Cancel pending work with an abort signal. Cancellation releases a waiting slot and does not erase previously acknowledged output. The module exposes a list of immutable receipt identifiers. It does not inspect unrelated projects. A caller supplies its own validated source references. Optional diagnostics record elapsed duration, queue depth and completed operations. Diagnostics disclose incomplete requests and do not mark a failed job successful.
